children: The Bank of England announced a plan to no longer sell gilts maturing after 2049, and reduced the pace of quantitative tightening to an average of 46 billion pounds per year until 2034, from 70 billion pounds per year currently. This announcement is driving gilt yields lower, TD Securities Pooja Kumra says in a note. U.K. 30-year gilt yields fall to a three-week low of around 5.731%, from 5.839% before the BOE's announcement, Tradeweb data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
